sections.content: Neuroscale AI is at the forefront of revolutionizing talent screening, decision-making, and acquisition through cutting-edge generative agentic AI. Our Minimum Viable Product (MVP) has demonstrated significant promise, and we are poised for expansion.

sections.heading: 📌 Role Details:
sections.content: We are seeking a Data Annotation Specialist Intern to join our team and contribute to the accuracy and consistency of our data processes. This internship offers an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a high-growth AI environment, with the potential to transition into a full-time role based on performance.

sections.heading: 🌐 What You'll Do:
sections.content:
Coordinate and Manage: Assist in overseeing the data review and annotation process, ensuring adherence to quality standards and project requirements.
Data Evaluation: Review and analyze datasets for accuracy, completeness, and consistency, identifying and addressing discrepancies or errors.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams to understand project objectives and requirements for data review and annotation.
Guideline Development: Help create guidelines, protocols, and standard operating procedures for data review and annotation activities.
Training Support: Collaborate in training data reviewers/annotators, offering guidance and feedback to achieve consistent results.
Quality Assurance: Participate in regular quality control checks on reviewed/annotated data, recommending corrective measures when necessary.
Process Improvement: Engage with cross-functional teams to address data-related issues and contribute to process enhancements.
Data Insights: Assist in data analysis tasks, providing insights and actionable recommendations based on reviewed/annotated data.

sections.heading: 🗝️ What We're Looking For:
sections.content:
Detail-Oriented: Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in reviewing and annotating data.
Team Player: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment.
Organizational Skills: Ability to prioritize tasks, manage time effectively, and adapt to changing project requirements.
Analytical Mindset: Problem-solving skills with a knack for identifying actionable insights.
Technical Acumen: Familiarity with data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, or data annotation platforms) is a plus.
Machine Learning Knowledge: Interest in machine learning and experience with data labeling for machine learning models is advantageous.
Programming Experience: Exposure to programming languages is a bonus but not required.

sections.heading: 💎 What You'll Gain:
sections.content:
Hands-on experience in data annotation and quality assurance within a cutting-edge AI organization.
Training and mentorship from experienced professionals.
Exposure to the latest trends in AI and machine learning.
Opportunity to contribute to impactful AI-driven projects.
Consideration for a full-time position based on your performance and company needs.

sections.heading: ❤️ Benefits for Interns:
sections.content:
Flexible hybrid working arrangements.
Access to professional development resources, including training sessions and learning stipends.
Networking opportunities through company-led events, workshops, and mentorship programs.
A dynamic, inclusive, and growth-oriented environment.
